lg.l:
You tokens diminute and lorn—(not
now the verdant scents of Maysy, nor July
cl clover bloom—no fruits of
August now;)

You pallid little banners, remnants
valueless—you overstay'd of
time,

You dear, soul dear, continued leaves, my
hardest and my last.
